_comment: SEMANTIC MUTATION TABLE. Deletion is the easy mutation; corruption is the one that matters,
because a dropped rule is a gap while an inverted rule is a lie that reads as authoritative.
Each entry is applied to the whole document and MUST be caught — the miss count must rise.
`node scripts/strategy-facts.mjs --mutate` fails the run if any mutant survives, which turns
adversarial mutation testing from an audit somebody happened to perform into a property the
repository owns and re-checks on every run.
Entries 1-6 are the coordinator's; 7-9 are Agent SOL's. Do not delete an entry because it
became inconvenient: a surviving mutant is a real hole in the checker, not a broken test.
